Results show arena lifecycle is <0.1% of total reparse cost (662ns vs 64µs small, 22.5µs vs 3.36ms large). Tree-sitter parsing dominates by 100-150x. Concluded arena reuse is not worth implementing. Added reset() method and investigation benchmarks. Filed marky-g9b epic for incremental tree-sitter parsing (the real performance opportunity) with 4 SRE-refined subtasks.
